On Walking (Henry David Thoreau)
- Your Highlight on Page 49 | On Walking | Added on Saturday, October 24, 2026, 10:19 AM

I have met with but one or two persons in the course of my life who understood the art of Walking, that is, of taking walks.
==========
Self-Reliance (Ralph Waldo Emerson)
- Your Highlight on Page 9 | Self-Reliance | Added on Saturday, October 24, 2026, 11:15 AM

Trust thyself: every heart vibrates to that iron string.
